# `^FO` – Field Origin

[Overview](../README.md) · [Libraries](../libraries/README.md) · [Commands](README.md) · [Features](../features/README.md) · [Evidence legend](../METHODOLOGY.md) · [Compare images](../../benchmarks/accuracy/README.md)


Set field origin (x,y) in dots, relative to label home (^LH). Optional z parameter sets justification (0=left, 1=right, 2=auto).

Reference parameters: **x, y, z**. These describe the reference grammar, not a promise that any library honors every parameter. [Zebra guide, page 201](../../zpl-zbi2-pg-en.pdf).
